notes.title: Zoo Economy Demo Update (0.12.2)
notes.notes:
We hope that you enjoy playing Zoo Economy Demo. Leave your feedback on community page or in our social networks.

Meanwhile we released a small update to the demo.

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] some localization errors and typos.
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] negative progress bar values in the 'My Task' menu.
[*] Now you will see exchange icon in 'Database' menu and in 'Info' at menu if you have high relation level with zoo.
[*] First tutorial mission was balanced to minimize situations when you won't be able to finish the mission.
[/list]
